operations.sqlite3:
CREATE INDEX idx_proposal_date
                ON proposals(business_date, generated_at)

CREATE TABLE adoption_reviews (
                    review_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    selection_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE automation_jobs (
                    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    business_date TEXT NOT NULL,
                    stage TEXT NOT NULL,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE company_research (
                    research_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    prediction_snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
                    reviewed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY(prediction_snapshot_id) REFERENCES prediction_snapshots(snapshot_id)
                )

CREATE TABLE daily_status (
                    business_date TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE decision_policy_snapshots (
                    proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    captured_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    engine_version TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES proposals(proposal_id)
                )

CREATE TABLE executions (
                    execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    decision_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    executed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY(decision_id) REFERENCES user_decisions(decision_id)
                )

CREATE TABLE import_previews (
                    preview_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    source_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE manual_portfolio_imports (
                    export_sha256 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    revision_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    revision_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    owner_scope_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL
                )
CREATE TABLE mobile_initial_confirmations(preview_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, confirmed_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE mobile_initial_previews(preview_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE mobile_personal_settings(sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, revision_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,payload TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE notifications (
                    notification_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES proposals(proposal_id)
                )

CREATE TABLE operational_metadata (
                    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    value TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE paper_calendars (
                    calendar_snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    source_snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE paper_outcomes (
                    outcome_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES proposals(proposal_id)
                )

CREATE TABLE portfolio_states (
                    portfolio_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    as_of TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE position_reconciliations (
                    preview_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    source_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE prediction_snapshots (
                    snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    as_of TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE process_locks (
                    lock_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    owner TEXT NOT NULL,
                    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE proposal_archives (
                    proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    archived_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES proposals(proposal_id)
                )

CREATE TABLE proposals (
                    proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    business_date TEXT NOT NULL,
                    as_of TEXT NOT NULL,
                    generated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    current_portfolio_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    archived_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY(current_portfolio_id) REFERENCES portfolio_states(portfolio_id)
                )

CREATE TABLE rankings (
                    ranking_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    as_of TEXT NOT NULL,
                    rank_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                    rank INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL
                )

CREATE TABLE user_decisions (
                    decision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    saved_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    UNIQUE(proposal_id, version),
                    FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES proposals(proposal_id)
                )
